#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

long long modPow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) res = (res * a) % MOD;
        a = (a * a) % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int n;
    long long k;
    cin >> n >> k;

    if (k >= n) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    vector<long long> fac(n + 1);
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % MOD;
    }

    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fac[n] << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    int c = n - (int)k;
    long long ans = fac[n] * modPow(fac[c], MOD - 2) % MOD;
    ans = ans * modPow(fac[n - c], MOD - 2) % MOD;

    long long tem = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
        long long comb = fac[c] * modPow(fac[i], MOD - 2) % MOD;
        comb = comb * modPow(fac[c - i], MOD - 2) % MOD;
        long long term = comb * modPow(c - i, n) % MOD;
        if (i % 2 == 0) {
            tem = (tem + term) % MOD;
        } else {
            tem = (tem + MOD - term) % MOD;
        }
    }

    ans = ans * tem % MOD * 2 % MOD;
    cout << ans << endl;

    return 0;
}
